hook.name: AutoBurnHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH-paired pools (currency0 must be ETH) that charges a configurable per-swap fee (default 1%). On ETH→token swaps, the collected ETH fee is routed through a nested swap via SwapExecutor and the resulting tokens are burned to the dead address. On token→ETH swaps, the collected token fee is transferred directly to the dead address.
